overview_description.description: Solomon provides tools to help businesses manage projects and collaborate efficiently in one platform. Solomon Labs' AI agent provides a solution that automates the entire process, from collecting client documents to extracting data and drafting tax returns and having AI replace repetitive and manual document work, accounting firms can accommodate more clients without additional personnel and focus on high-value-added services such as high-quality tax consulting. Furthermore, the company plans to expand the scope of tax automation by covering various federal tax items, such as student loans and alimony, as well as broadening the number of applicable states. The company focuses on automating high-volume tax workflows involving K-1s, Schedule E filings, brokerage statements, and other complex financial documents.
